brief: Light rainfall. Delicate irregular tiny water drops form a soft continuous rain patter. Isolated rainfall sound effect.
Gentle rainfall, a quiet fine watery patter with softly overlapping small droplets. Isolated continuous rain sound effect.
Steady rainfall. Dense overlapping water droplets create an even natural rain patter with a soft low water wash. Isolated continuous rainfall sound effect.
Moderate rainfall, a full continuous watery patter of countless small droplets with gently varying density. Isolated rain sound effect.
Torrential rainfall. An intense continuous dense wall of falling water and overlapping droplets creates a powerful broad rain wash. Isolated downpour sound effect.
Heavy rainfall, a dense strong downpour with thick low water wash and tightly overlapping tiny water droplets. Isolated continuous rain sound effect.
A single thunderclap. A short sharp powerful crack followed by deep rolling rumble decaying gradually into silence. Isolated thunder sound effect.
One low thunder peal, a broad initial clap with an uneven deep rolling rumble fading to silence. Isolated thunder sound effect.
One thunder crash followed by a layered low rolling rumble and a long quiet decay. An isolated single thunder sound effect.
One thunderclap, a short crackling attack immediately followed by a deep bass rumble fading completely away. Isolated thunder sound effect.
